behavior: Create a wallet, register fallback, then board confirmed funds.
expected: Board works only with the valid link/record; principal and actual fees reconcile.

behavior: Attempt boarding while the funding confirmation requirement is unmet, then retry.
expected: Expected wait/refusal; one eventual funded board, no duplicate liability.

behavior: Board, finish registration, and never return.
expected: Exactly one expiry payout to this owner's registered BIP84 script.

behavior: Broadcast a board, disappear before board registration finishes.
expected: Pending-board source eventually pays its owner after real sweep evidence.

behavior: Get board cosign/proposal but never broadcast its funding transaction.
expected: No fictitious principal, sweep or payout; no server-funded gift.

behavior: Create and use several boards in one wallet.
expected: Distinct real entitlements; expiry grouping/fees reconcile.

behavior: Send arkoor to an online recipient.
expected: Recipient owns transferred value; sender change remains sender's.

behavior: Send to a previously advertised address of a now-offline recipient.
expected: Posted/registered recipient output pays the recipient at expiry without returning.

behavior: Receive several payments while offline.
expected: All delivered entitled amounts group correctly, once.

behavior: Spend only part of a coin through arkoor.
expected: Recipient and change have correct links, amounts, and future payouts.

behavior: Forward received value across three owners.
expected: Final live entitlement is counted once; predecessors cannot receive it again.

behavior: Send several payments to the same offline wallet.
expected: One destination group rather than a per-coin minimum test.

behavior: Accept an arkoor, disconnect before local sync finishes, then reconnect.
expected: Server/local state converges without duplicate spend or balance.

behavior: Lose the response to a money-moving request.
expected: Driver reconciles IDs/status before retry; actual committed action counted once.

behavior: Disconnect the sender before signed transfer delivery/posting.
expected: Unregistered source follows the input-owner rule unless recipient registration wins first.

behavior: Deliver/register that transfer before the expiry settlement commits.
expected: Recipient entitlement wins; sender receives only legitimate change.

behavior: Perform an ordinary interactive refresh.
expected: Replacement appears once; temporary round capital lock is measured.

behavior: Keep refreshing for several lifetimes.
expected: Old/new backing overlaps are measured; fees and reusable principal remain distinct.

behavior: Refresh close to the real eligibility boundary.
expected: One valid refresh or one payout; stale inputs are never funded twice.

behavior: Start a delegated refresh and immediately go offline.
expected: Server completes it or resolves its unclaimed source under actual protocol rules.

behavior: Schedule a delegated refresh for a later valid height, then disappear.
expected: Scheduled output is linked; later expiry pays the correct wallet.

behavior: Drop an hArk completion/unlock step.
expected: Unclaimed replacements/predecessors resolve once under the documented rules.

behavior: Go offline for less than a lifetime and return.
expected: Sync/refresh works; no phantom on-chain payment.

behavior: Return after expiry but before durable payout commitment.
expected: Valid return action and payout arbitrate; at most one resulting entitlement.

behavior: Return after payout confirmation.
expected: Ark value removed, on-chain value visible, address rotation recorded.

behavior: Recover an absent paid owner using the mnemonic alone.
expected: Gap-20 BIP84 scan finds and spends the real output with no Ark-state hints.

behavior: Reopen on a second device with the same seed.
expected: Fallback state converges; no competing record or double entitlement.

behavior: Restart a wallet before the reserved fallback address receives anything.
expected: Ordinary receives do not reuse its reservation improperly.

behavior: Rotate fallback after a payout, then abandon a later coin.
expected: Committed old payout stays at its old script; later payout uses the new record.

behavior: Receive amounts that are individually small but jointly payable.
expected: Grouped net threshold releases them exactly once.

behavior: Hold an aggregate balance below the actual net minimum.
expected: Explicit retained obligation, unpaid age and fee sensitivity; never reported as paid.

behavior: Add later eligible value to that retained wallet.
expected: It becomes payable after grouping when the actual net reaches the minimum.

behavior: Offboard voluntarily while online.
expected: One on-chain entitlement; no expiry refund for offboarded predecessors.

behavior: Start a unilateral exit on this actor's own coin.
expected: Exact backing path prevents an overlapping automatic payout; watchman burden measured.

behavior: Pay a controlled external LN invoice successfully, then disappear.
expected: Payee paid; no sender refund of successful principal; change still recoverable.

behavior: Have an external LN send fail terminally, then disappear before revocation.
expected: Failed send is automatically paid back to sender when independently eligible.

behavior: Receive an external LN payment and finish the claim normally.
expected: Collected value appears once; channel/on-chain capital changes reconcile.

behavior: Complete the collection-enabling receive phase, then disappear before final claim delivery.
expected: Verified collected receive gets the correct automatic payout; return drops stale claimable value.

behavior: Prepare a receive but never reveal/commit what permits collection.
expected: External payment fails back or internal sender eventually gets the rightful refund; no unfunded recipient payout.

behavior: Pay another Bark actor through internal LN: exercise both normal completion and a disappearing recipient.
expected: Correct internal settlement or refund; do not fabricate external channel movement.

behavior: Register another wallet's fallback using the attacker's signature.
expected: Refused; victim record unchanged.

behavior: Alter the script in a signed fallback record.
expected: Signature verification rejects it.

behavior: Alter the sequence in a signed fallback record.
expected: Signature verification rejects it.

behavior: Replay a correctly signed record bound to another genesis hash.
expected: Refused; no cross-chain record replay.

behavior: Replay an older valid record after a newer record exists.
expected: Stored newer record survives; no rollback.

behavior: Submit a different script with the same record sequence.
expected: Deterministic stored-record rule; no unsigned/ambiguous replacement.

behavior: Mix a valid record with invalid links in one request.
expected: No unauthorized record/link partial application.

behavior: Forge a coin-key link for a victim public key.
expected: Refused; coin cannot be redirected.

behavior: Replace the mailbox in an otherwise signed key link.
expected: Refused; signature binds the wallet identity.

behavior: Replay one coin key's link for another key.
expected: Refused.

behavior: Relink an already linked key using another mailbox.
expected: Immutable link survives.

behavior: Request board creation without a link/record.
expected: Creation refusal; no funded uncovered coin.

behavior: Request a round output without a link/record.
expected: Creation refusal.

behavior: Request arkoor creation without a link/record.
expected: Creation refusal.

behavior: Request a Lightning receive output without a link/record.
expected: Creation refusal before unfunded/incorrect entitlement.

behavior: Request a Lightning-send/change output without a link/record.
expected: Creation refusal for the actual output path under test.

behavior: Race two arkoor spends of the same input to different owned recipients.
expected: At most one accepted successor path.

behavior: Race arkoor against interactive refresh of the same input.
expected: One winner; losing request cannot claim another payout.

behavior: Race offboard against refresh of the same input.
expected: One paid/successor entitlement.

behavior: Race unilateral exit against cooperative spending.
expected: Chain and protocol arbitration prevent two funded claims; exact path recorded.

behavior: Replay a spend of an expiry-settled coin.
expected: Settled refusal; no new amount or service crash.

behavior: Replay a delivered chain/mailbox message.
expected: No duplicate credit, liability, or future payout.

behavior: Submit an altered/incomplete signed transfer chain for registration.
expected: Invalid proof rejected; no payee change.

behavior: Deliver a previously unregistered chain after its input-owner payout committed.
expected: Delivery/registration refused as settled; no second recipient payment.

behavior: Combine independent input-owner chains and try to attribute all outputs to one owner.
expected: Each actual parent controls its entitlement; attacker cannot collect another parent's amount.

behavior: Race two delegated refresh requests on identical inputs.
expected: One exchange or consistent refusal, never duplicated replacements.

behavior: Resubmit cached forfeit/completion data after expiry cancellation.
expected: Canceled/settled participation cannot be revived for another payment.

behavior: Present an unrelated branch's confirmed sweep as proof for this coin.
expected: This coin stays unpaid until its own path satisfies the proof.

behavior: Request a refund for a successful Lightning send.
expected: Refused even if a client missed its successful response/preimage.

behavior: Request a refund while the Lightning result is still unknown/pending.
expected: No refund based only on silence or a client timeout.

behavior: Replay a completed receive claim.
expected: No second credit/payout.

behavior: Submit a wrong preimage for a prepared receive.
expected: Cannot collect or redirect value; rightful resolution remains possible.

behavior: Claim an internal receive after a sender refund committed.
expected: Refused; no late recipient creation over refunded funds.

behavior: Revoke the sender while a valid internal recipient claim is committing.
expected: Recipient's valid claim and refund arbitrate once.

behavior: Request an excessive or invalid block-height expiry on a legitimately collected receive.
expected: Bounded refusal, no panic; no attacker-chosen far-future reclaim lock.

behavior: Keep a prepared internal receive unfinished to immobilize sender funds.
expected: Refund/claim deadline resolves ownership; lock duration and capital cost measured.

behavior: Send many small valid coins to an absent owner (bounded fragmentation).
expected: Grouped payment remains possible; old 101-coin blockage must not recur.

behavior: Repeatedly join and abandon round participation at different client stages.
expected: Bounded lock duration, eventual valid-source resolution; ordinary actors still progress.

behavior: Repeated valid read/record/invoice requests with capped rate and count.
expected: Measure amplification, row growth, RPC latency and operator costs; no loss/misdirection.

behavior: Malformed/truncated/oversized requests within the declared test cap.
expected: Controlled refusal/size limit; captaind stays healthy and honest actors progress.
